cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Admit You Need Me
cards.instruction: Make someone admit that they need your help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. That flat-pack cupboard's leaning. I could take a look.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Wonderful. Which page explains that leftover door?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you hold it for a second?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. Just to clarify: you're asking for my help?

mechanism: A demonstrates sole assembly competence through specific corrections, then uses B expanding requests to obtain an explicit admission of needing help.
confusable: General condescension lacks a patient corrective sequence tied to real mistakes and increasing strain.
comparison: The heater alternative concerns diagnosis and control use rather than supporting a partly built object.
seedUse: Cupboard seed supplies leaning frame and limited-help request; S03 flour/piano seeds guide concrete correction and a workable procedure rather than pasted expert slogans.
